messages:
sasha_support: Heads up, Acme reports failures when calling chat.create from our Node SDK after last night's changes. They didn't change code.
mark_engineer: Any error text or example code from them?
sasha_support: They provided this snippet and error:
```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.chat.create({ input: 'Summarize the Q3 notes' })
```
Error: 404 Not Found: route not found
SDK: @redwood/inference@0.19.0
node: 18.16.0

ingrid_repro: I reproduced locally. The SDK at 0.19.0 still calls POST /v1/chat with a body {input: string}. Our API now expects POST /v1/chat/create and the payload shape messages: [{role, content}]. Without the gateway shim, the endpoint returns 404.
mark_engineer: We changed the route naming 2 days ago and removed the hosted compatibility proxy in the last deploy to match dedicated/private behavior.
devon_platform: Short term options: (1) re-add a hosted proxy, (2) ship a tiny patch to the SDK that translates the old call shape to the new route, or (3) tell customers to switch to raw HTTP. Which is fastest?
mark_engineer: Patch to SDK is straightforward and safest. I'll prepare a 0.19.1 patch that maps client.chat.create({input}) -> POST /v1/chat/create with messages array. If we need faster, ops can re-enable a hosted-only proxy.

ingrid_repro: Repro steps I used:
1) npm i @redwood/inference@0.19.0
2) node -e "(async()=>{const c=require('@redwood/inference').default({apiKey:process.env.RW_KEY}); await c.chat.create({input:'hi'})})()"
3) Observe 404 and response body: {"error":"route not found","expected":"/v1/chat/create"}

Quick customer workaround (raw curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/create \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q3"}]}'
```
Or tiny Node shim until they upgrade:
```js
const client = require('@redwood/inference').default({apiKey:process.env.RW_KEY})
const fetch = require('node-fetch')
await fetch('https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat/create',{ 
  method:'POST',
  headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},
  body:JSON.stringify({messages:[{role:'user',content:'Summarize Q3'}]})
})
```

mark_engineer: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/982 (compat shim + tests). Plan: cut 0.19.1 within 2 hours if CI passes.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline queued for branch hotfix/sdk-compat-shim (job #5481)

devon_platform: Ops agreed to a temporary hosted proxy mapping POST /v1/chat -> /v1/chat/create for two weeks. Also added a short circuit to avoid rate storms from legacy clients.

sasha_support: I'll relay the workaround & ETA to the customer. They also asked about billing and retries — any notes?
ingrid_repro: 404s triggered client retries causing extra requests. No double-charge for token generation, but customers may see additional API request billing for retries depending on their retry policy.

mark_engineer: Actions: ship 0.19.1 (mark), deploy hosted proxy for 2 weeks (devon), send customer comms and postmortem (sasha).
sasha_support: Thanks. I'll follow up with Acme and mark this thread resolved until they confirm upgrade. :white_check_mark:
